_comment: Phase-A judge panel (2026-09-23). Three open-weight judges from families disjoint from every evaluated family (alibaba, lg, kakao, google, naver); leave-one-family-out therefore removes no judge. Local snapshot paths are used because the judges live in two HF caches (Llama in fusion1's read-only ~/.cache/huggingface; Mistral and Phi-4 in adol's models/hf). gpu_memory_utilization 0.85: judges run one at a time on a pinned, otherwise idle GPU. Manual and anchors are shared (judge prompt v0.3 = src/kyra/judge_prompt_v0_3.md, the protocol's one revision; research/judge_anchors_v1.json). DECODE PATH (DECISION_LOG 2026-09-23 ~05:15Z): batch_size 64 per judge (below) + the scoring process must export VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 and KYRA_VLLM_ENGINE_KWARGS='{"attention_backend": "FLASH_ATTN"}' — both are recorded in each judge's sidecar meta (provider_effective_params.vllm_env / engine_kwargs); a scoring run whose sidecars lack them is not the pinned procedure.
